checks.sentence: 20 Microns Nano Minerals Limited processes and sells specialty chemicals — Functional Additives, Chemically Modified Minerals, Soft Minerals and Hard Minerals — and relies on its corporate promoter 20 Microns Limited for marketing and distribution.
checks.supporting_excerpt_quote: Our Company is engaged in processing and selling of a wide range of Specialty Chemicals which primarily include (i) Functional Additives (FA) & (ii) Chemically Modified Minerals (CMM). Our Company is also engaged in processing and selling of (i) Soft Minerals (SM) & (ii) Hard Minerals (HM). We have a long term arrangement with our Corporate Promoter to market and sell our products through their network.
